batches.name: South River
batches.why: Three parishes in one town (Raritan Bay Deanery), each with its own pastor in the finder: Corpus Christi, St. Mary of Ostrabrama (eCatholic 11802), St. Stephen Protomartyr. Check whether any two print one bulletin.

batches.name: Bound Brook and South Bound Brook
batches.why: St. Joseph (John Patrick Publishing, jppc 557, site dreamsofstjoseph.org), St. Mary of Czestochowa and Our Lady of Mercy, South Bound Brook (site moved to Google Sites). Separate pastors/administrators in the finder.

batches.name: Sayreville and Parlin
batches.why: Our Lady of Victories and St. Stanislaus Kostka (Sayreville) and St. Bernadette (Parlin); no finder website for any. The finder names Rev. David J. Pekola as Our Lady of Victories' pastor, the same name as Belvidere/Oxford 60 km away: check the parish's own pastor.

batches.name: South Amboy and Matawan
batches.why: Sacred Heart and St. Mary (South Amboy; St. Mary is eCatholic 34325, Sacred Heart's finder domain is dead) and Most Holy Redeemer, Matawan (eCatholic 15478). Two South Amboy parishes with separate pastors: check for a shared bulletin.

batches.name: Old Bridge Township
batches.why: St. Ambrose, St. Thomas the Apostle (saintthomasob.com: probe url says SPAM-SQUAT, verify) and St. Lawrence, Laurence Harbor (in Old Bridge Twp). St. Ambrose hosts a Coptic Catholic Mass in its St. Anthony Room.

batches.name: East Brunswick, Milltown, North Brunswick, Spotswood
batches.why: Four neighbouring Forsgate Deanery parishes, each with its own pastor: St. Bartholomew (no finder website), Our Lady of Lourdes Milltown, Our Lady of Peace North Brunswick (eCatholic 30376), Immaculate Conception Spotswood (eCatholic 17811).

batches.name: Monroe, Jamesburg, Helmetta
batches.why: Nativity of Our Lord (Wix PDFs), St. James the Less (no finder website) and Holy Trinity, Helmetta (no finder website): adjacent towns; check the two without sites for a shared or absent bulletin.

batches.name: Plainsboro, South Brunswick, Montgomery
batches.why: Queenship of Mary (site answers 403), St. Cecilia Monmouth Junction (eCatholic 22492), St. Augustine Kendall Park and St. Charles Borromeo, Skillman.

batches.name: Metuchen and Edison
batches.why: The Cathedral of St. Francis of Assisi (Discover Mass; GCatholic omits it), St. Helena (no finder website) and St. Matthew the Apostle (LPi id and eCatholic 22680 on its site).

batches.name: Woodbridge, Iselin, Avenel, Colonia
batches.why: St. Cecelia, Iselin and St. James, Woodbridge share a pastor in the finder (Rev. Thomas Naduviledathu, SDV): check for one bulletin. With St. Andrew, Avenel and St. John Vianney, Colonia.

batches.name: Carteret and Port Reading
batches.why: Divine Mercy (church-bulletin.org; finder lists only Holy Family Church as its worship site, GCatholic also lists Sacred Heart and St. Elizabeth of Hungary, Carteret), St. Joseph, Carteret (finder domain dead) and St. Anthony of Padua, Port Reading with Our Lady of Mount Carmel, Woodbridge (two worship sites). Several Carteret closures to date.

batches.name: North Plainfield, Dunellen, Middlesex
batches.why: St. Joseph and St. Luke, North Plainfield merged as Sts. Joseph and Luke on 1 July 2025 (decree on diometuchen.org) but the finder still lists both; sjnp.org now redirects to sjlnp.org (John Patrick, jppc 685). With St. John the Evangelist, Dunellen and Our Lady of Mount Virgin, Middlesex (eCatholic 21774).

batches.name: South Plainfield and Piscataway
batches.why: Sacred Heart and Our Lady of Czestochowa (South Plainfield), Our Lady of Fatima and St. Frances Cabrini (Piscataway). Separate pastors in the finder; Czestochowa and Cabrini have no finder website.

batches.name: Raritan and Bridgewater (Oratory)
batches.why: St. Ann and St. Joseph (Raritan) and Holy Trinity, Bridgewater are all staffed by the Raritan Oratory of St. Philip Neri (finder: 'under the pastoral care of the priests and brothers of the Congregation of the Oratory'); check for a shared bulletin. GCatholic adds a Blessed Sacrament shrine chapel at 50 W Somerset St, Raritan. stannparish.com gets SPAM-SQUAT from the probes (verify); St. Joseph's finder site is a dead weconnect.com address.

batches.name: Somerville, Manville, Bridgewater
batches.why: Immaculate Conception, Somerville (eCatholic 22346), Christ the Redeemer, Manville (two worship sites: Christ the King and Sacred Heart) and St. Bernard of Clairvaux, Bridgewater.

batches.name: Hillsborough, Millstone, Somerset
batches.why: Mary, Mother of God (eCatholic 24130; no pastor listed in the finder), St. Joseph, Millstone (site moved to sjmillstone.com) and St. Matthias, Somerset (eCatholic 29319).

batches.name: Bernardsville, Peapack-Far Hills, Basking Ridge
batches.why: St. Elizabeth-St. Brigid (one parish, two finder pins and two churches), Our Lady of Perpetual Help, Bernardsville (its Mass schedule names a Sacred Heart Chapel) and St. James, Basking Ridge.

batches.name: Warren, Watchung, Martinsville
batches.why: Our Lady of the Mount, Warren, St. Mary-Stony Hill, Watchung and Blessed Sacrament, Martinsville (finder worship site 1890 Washington Valley Road; finder pin and GCatholic give 852 Newmans Lane).

batches.name: Flemington, Readington, Whitehouse, Annandale
batches.why: St. Magdalen de Pazzi, St. Elizabeth Ann Seton (Three Bridges), Our Lady of Lourdes (Whitehouse Station; ParishesOnline) and Immaculate Conception, Annandale. Separate pastors in the finder.

batches.name: Frenchtown, Milford, Pittstown, Lambertville
batches.why: Our Lady of Victories (Frenchtown/Baptistown) and St. Edward the Confessor, Milford share a pastor in the finder (Fr. Bede Kim): check for one bulletin. With St. Catherine of Siena, Pittstown and St. John the Evangelist, Lambertville with St. Agnes, Stockton (two worship sites).

batches.name: High Bridge, Califon, Hampton
batches.why: St. Joseph, High Bridge (ParishesOnline), St. John Neumann, Califon (John Patrick, jppc 652) and St. Ann, Hampton (no finder website).

batches.name: Phillipsburg, Alpha, Bloomsbury
batches.why: St. Philip and St. James, Phillipsburg, St. Mary, Alpha (eCatholic 22631) and Annunciation, Bloomsbury (John Patrick, jppc 589). Across the river from Easton (Allentown diocese).

batches.name: Belvidere, Oxford, Blairstown, Great Meadows
batches.why: St. Patrick, Belvidere and St. Rose of Lima, Oxford share a pastor (Rev. David J. Pekola) and one website (stpatrickrose.org, ParishesOnline 04/0870): likely one bulletin. With St. Jude, Blairstown and Ss. Peter and Paul, Great Meadows.

batches.name: Washington, Port Murray, Hackettstown
batches.why: St. Joseph, Washington, St. Theodore, Port Murray (finder domain dead) and Assumption, Hackettstown (no finder website). GCatholic adds the Our Lady of Fatima shrine (World Apostolate of Fatima, Washington Twp): no parish of its own, so see whether it publishes anything.

batches.name: New Brunswick: Holy Family and Visitation
batches.why: Two merged city parishes with three churches each (finder): Holy Family (Sacred Heart, St. Joseph, St. Ladislaus) and Visitation (St. John the Baptist, St. Mary of Mount Virgin, St. Theresa, Edison; eCatholic 23109). GCatholic's St. Lucy Filippini shrine has St. Mary of Mount Virgin's address. GCatholic and the finder disagree on St. Ladislaus's address. City centre with likely closures: fewer parishes.

batches.name: New Brunswick and Highland Park
batches.why: Our Lady of Mount Carmel, St. Peter the Apostle University and Community Parish (Rutgers; eCatholic 21126) and Transfiguration of the Lord, Highland Park (Guardian Angels, Edison and St. Paul the Apostle, Highland Park; ParishesOnline 04/1001).

batches.name: Perth Amboy: Most Holy Name and Our Lady of Fatima
batches.why: Most Holy Name of Jesus (eCatholic 22505; Holy Trinity and Our Lady of Hungary worship sites, and Spanish Masses 'La Asuncion' at 777 Cortlandt St) and Our Lady of Fatima. GCatholic's St. Mary, 104 Center St has no parish in the finder: settle where it went (it may belong to St. John Paul II).

batches.name: Perth Amboy, Hopelawn, Fords
batches.why: St. John Paul II (Our Lady of the Rosary of Fatima and St. Stephen), Good Shepherd, Hopelawn (eCatholic 25544; Our Lady of the Most Holy Rosary) and Our Lady of Peace, Fords. GCatholic's Holy Spirit, 580 Hazel Ave, Perth Amboy has no parish in the finder: settle where it went (likely Good Shepherd or St. John Paul II).

batches.name: Eastern Catholic churches in the territory
batches.why: GCatholic's 16 Eastern Catholic entries (Ruthenian, Ukrainian, Maronite, Syro-Malabar), under their own eparchies; the diocese counts 15 Eastern Church parishes. Expect other-jurisdiction exclusions; one Ukrainian entry is a former church.
